_note: Non-Roman images made by Codex with its built-in image generation (IMAGE_PROVIDER=codex_builtin, the default; openrouter is the opt-in alternative). `ca` writes one job per image under outputs/<jobs_dir>/<batch>/<job>/job.json; Codex generates it once and runs `ca image import`. sizes: the size Codex generates per requested aspect; the app then crops it to the aspect and draws the design on the final canvas. $0 per image: the authorization caps the count (unit codex_images). Roman stays on Higgsfield Soul 2.0.
